The Dynamic Madrid Limited Elite DYN-6310-04 Elite is a 3-person ultra low EMF FAR infrared sauna engineered around one standout feature: 360-degree heating coverage. Unlike standard 3-person saunas that place panels only on the rear and side walls, the Madrid Elite positions its 7 PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF carbon heating panels on all 4 interior walls — rear, both sides, and the front — delivering infrared warmth from every direction simultaneously. The result is faster heat-up, more even temperature distribution, and more complete full-body coverage than a conventional panel layout at the same capacity.

Ultra low EMF between 3–5 MG measured 2–3 inches from the panels keeps electromagnetic exposure meaningfully lower than standard low EMF saunas (5–10 MG) while staying accessible at a price point below the full spectrum near zero EMF models. For buyers who do daily sessions and want a 3-person cabin with strong EMF credentials, the Madrid Elite sits at the right point in the lineup.

The 360-degree heating approach also changes the session experience in a practical way. In a standard rear-and-side panel layout, your back receives the most direct infrared exposure while your front receives secondary warmth from radiated heat. The Madrid Elite's front wall panels close that gap — your chest, torso, and front of your legs receive the same direct infrared as your back, making the session more balanced and therapeutically complete. The easy removable bench extends the unit's utility further, converting the interior to an open floor plan suitable for stretching, yoga, or light exercise — a feature that adds genuine daily-use versatility beyond traditional seated sauna sessions.

The cabin is built from natural reforested Canadian Hemlock in a Honey Dark Stain finish, with a tempered glass door and side window, interior chromotherapy color lighting system with Red Light Therapy, and exterior accent lighting that gives the unit a polished presence in any room. The interior LED control panel manages temperature, timer, and lighting, and Bluetooth audio with 2 built-in speakers and pre-amp integrates your audio seamlessly. Temperature runs ideally between 118°F and 132°F with a maximum of 140°F.

Electrical requirements call for a 120V/20 AMP dedicated Non-GFCI receptacle and breaker — a dedicated circuit is required, and a licensed electrician should be consulted if one isn't already available at your installation site. This is the same electrical requirement as other 3-person Dynamic models with 20 AMP circuits. The unit ships in 3 boxes at 400 lbs and uses clasp-together panel assembly suitable for two people.

Dynamic Saunas is produced by Golden Designs, Inc., a California company dedicated exclusively to home infrared sauna wellness. The Elite line uses PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF carbon heating technology — calibrated to the 3–5 MG range for buyers who want meaningfully reduced EMF in a proven FAR infrared format. The 5-year limited warranty covers wood, structure, heating elements, and electronics.
